title: After homicide ruling, Boston councilor wants officers involved in South Bay jail death placed on leave
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Councilor Miniard Culpepper urges administrative leave for officers involved in Shacoby Kenny's in-custody death at South Bay jail.
The state medical examiner ruled Kenny's December 2025 death a homicide due to lack of oxygen and blood to the brain.
Culpepper plans to introduce a resolution for suspension of officers while Attorney General's investigation continues.

title: Norwood Hospital moves closer to being acquired through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Massachusetts Senate approved a bill to seize Norwood Hospital through eminent domain to aid construction and ownership transfer.
Norwood Hospital has been closed since 2020 flood; Steward Health Care halted construction amid bankruptcy.
Medical Properties Trust opposes seizure, claiming over $350 million investment and urging completion of construction.

title: Patriots rookie Eli Raridon is looking like a potential Day 1 contributor
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Rookie tight end Eli Raridon shines at Patriots training camp, emerging as a potential key player despite being a third-round draft pick.
Julian Hill's season-ending injury opens the door for Raridon to secure the backup tight end role behind Hunter Henry.
Raridon's athleticism and adaptability in New England's offense impress coach Mike Vrabel and enhance his chances of playing time.

title: Were they dishonest with me at the quick lube shop?
author: John Paul
bullets: A quick lube shop recommended replacing air filters to a customer who had them changed nine months ago.
Quick lube recommendations may rely on computer service history rather than actual part inspection.
Getting a second opinion on car maintenance recommendations is advisable to assess necessity and accuracy.

title: Abington police officer placed on leave after chase of stolen car ends in crash that killed 17-year-old boy
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Abington officer on leave after fatal crash following chase of a stolen SUV on Washington St.
17-year-old driver dead, four teen passengers hospitalized after stolen SUV crash in Abington.
Abington police officer's administrative leave is for investigation, not punishment, says Chief Bonney.

title: Madden 27 Ratings: Christian Gonzalez is NFL’s top-ranked CB in new game
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Christian Gonzalez is the highest-rated cornerback at 98 overall in Madden 27, leading five players with this rating.
Seven cornerbacks, including Patrick Surtain II and Trent McDuffie, have ratings of 90 or higher in the game.
Madden 27 releases on August 13, with early access available from August 6.

title: Jeff Passan floats blockbuster trade for Red Sox and Marlins
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Red Sox aim to trade with the Marlins for Otto Lopez and Liam Hicks before the MLB trade deadline.
Lopez, a shortstop, has a .329 average with 27 doubles, while catcher Hicks has hit 14 home runs this season.
ESPN's Jeff Passan suggests the Red Sox may trade prospects like Franklin Arias to acquire Lopez and Hicks.

title: Death of woman, 18, found dead in Mattapan home owned by Pressley’s husband ruled a homicide
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Yoseliani Ann Marte Ocasio, 18, was found dead from a gunshot wound in a Mattapan home on July 18.
The Mattapan property where Marte Ocasio was shot is owned by Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley's husband, Conan Harris.
Boston police have ruled the death a homicide, are investigating, and no arrests have been made yet.

title: Caleb Lomu is learning more than just right tackle at his first training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Caleb Lomu is gaining experience at multiple positions, including right tackle, guard, and jumbo tight end at Patriots camp.
Coach Mike Vrabel praises Lomu's versatility and learning speed, noting he rarely makes the same mistake twice.
Lomu primarily played left tackle in college but is embracing the opportunity to learn various positions in the NFL.

title: Kayshon Boutte addresses trade rumors, future with Patriots
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Kayshon Boutte addresses trade rumors but focuses on current role with the New England Patriots.
Patriots' coach Mike Vrabel open to trading players due to a crowded wide receiver lineup.
Boutte remains a key player in training camp, maintaining strong performance despite potential trade talks.
